security.title: Two-step sign-in
security.intro: A second check after your email code, for sensitive areas. Required for G-ventZ staff and recommended for hosts. Use a passkey (your fingerprint, face or device PIN) or an authenticator app.
security.done: Two-step sign-in is on and this session is confirmed.
security.removeFailed: That couldn't be removed. Confirm it's you first, then try again.
security.passkeyHint: Confirm with Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello, your phone or a security key. Nothing to type.
security.confirmHintContinue: Use one of your methods to continue.
security.orCode: Or enter the code from your authenticator app:
security.methodsNote: This session is confirmed. Keep at least two methods (for example a passkey and the app) so losing one device doesn't lock you out.

mfa.step1: Open an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…).
mfa.step2: Scan this QR code, or type the key below.
mfa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app

errors.generic: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.setupFailed: Two-step sign-in couldn't be set up right now. Please try again.
errors.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
errors.wrongCode: That code isn't right, or it expired. Try the current one.
errors.setUpFirst: Set up an authenticator app first.

passkey.unsupported: This browser doesn't support passkeys. Use the authenticator app instead.

errors.createFailed: This device couldn't create a passkey. Try another device or the authenticator app.
errors.useFailed: That passkey couldn't be used on this device.
errors.generic: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.disabled: Passkeys aren't switched on for this site yet.
errors.notConfirmed: That passkey couldn't be confirmed. Please try again.

payouts.title: Get paid
payouts.intro: Sell paid tickets on G-ventZ. Guests pay with Paystack or Flutterwave, and your share goes straight to your bank account.

ok.submitted: Application sent. We'll email you when it's decided.
ok.payoutChanged: Payout details changed. Paid sales pause until G-ventZ confirms the new account; we've emailed you.
ok.bankChosen: Bank saved. Your payout account with this provider is being set up.

payouts.loadFailed: We couldn't load your payout details. Please refresh the page.

status.title: Paid tickets
status.name: Name
status.owedNote: This is your share of refunded tickets or lost chargebacks. It's taken from your next paid sales automatically. Until it's paid back you can't publish new paid events; your existing events keep selling.

account.pendingNote: G-ventZ is setting this account up with the payment provider. You can sell paid tickets once it's active.

form.help: We use these details to pay you through our payment providers, Paystack and Flutterwave. A person at G-ventZ checks each application, usually within two working days.

form.changeNote: For your safety you'll confirm it's you with two-step sign-in. Paid sales pause until G-ventZ confirms the new account, and we email you about the change.

bank.cantCheck: Account names can't be checked automatically in this country. Check the bank and number carefully: payouts go to exactly this account.

security.title: Sign-in & security
security.intro: You sign in with a code sent to your email, so there is no password to remember. Add a passkey or an authenticator app as a second step for extra protection.
security.confirmHint: Confirm it's you with one of your methods to manage them.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.hint: Signed in on a shared or lost device? Sign out everywhere, including here.
sessions.confirmText: You'll be signed out on every phone, tablet and computer, including this one. Tickets saved for offline use on this device are removed.
